purpose: VICOBA and savings-group names that many unrelated groups share. A common name never produces a possible-duplicate candidate across wards or councils: two groups with a common name are the same group only when their full key (council, ward and normalised name) is equal, or their registration numbers are equal within one registration authority (docs/plans/vicoba-integration-plan.md, decision 2b, rule 3). Read by scripts/collection/build_vicoba_intake.py.
basis: The integration plan's list (Upendo, Tumaini, Umoja, Mshikamano, Juhudi, Faraja, Neema, Amani) extended with Kiswahili and English words that are used as group names across Tanzania. It is a matching aid, not a register: no group is created from it. Compare names after normalisation (lower case, accents and punctuation removed, the words VICOBA, VIKOBA, VSLA, Kikundi cha, Kikundi, Group, Women Group, Wanawake and Vijana taken out).
